sourceRefs.locator: IV.79, pp. 66–67, including n. 1. Illness at Épinay, Aega, Nanthild, Clovis and burial at Saint-Denis. Wallace-Hadrill follows Courtois in dating the death to 638.
ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.
Section H, “Le roi Dagobert”: tomb monument commissioned in the thirteenth century, the soul transported in a boat and rescued by Saints Denis, Maurice and Martin.

labels.en: Burial of Dagobert I recorded in writing

summary.de: Der Chronist und eine Urkunde seines Sohnes bezeugen die Bestattung in der Kirche. Das heute sichtbare königliche Grabmonument entstand erst im 13. Jahrhundert.
summary.en: The chronicle and his son’s charter attest the king’s burial in the church. The royal tomb monument visible today was made in the thirteenth century.
